policy: Select the issuer-documented current project token only with explicit lineage/contract/provider evidence. Preserve legacy symbols/mappings and stable project IDs; current-token prices must not be labelled as legacy-asset prices. No transaction, entitlement assumption, historical-price joining or unit scaling. Retain quarantine until a fresh strict audit; reject duplicate successor IDs already tracked elsewhere.
